Nebraska researchers are studying which trees southern flying squirrels call home.

Woods Run Digest subscribers already knew that.

From the November 6, 2026 edition of The Woods Run Digest. University of Nebraska–Lincoln researchers are examining tree age, species, canopy cover and cavities on East Campus; the study is ongoing.
